COUPLING_ENFORCE: Turns the docs-impact check (tools/docs_coupling.py) from report-only into a gate: when 1/true/on, a page that declares `covers:` and was not updated fails the run. Off by default.
DOCS_API: Where the wiki's visual review script sends `/api` requests so live widgets show real data (default: production).
DOCS_PAGE_ACTIONS: `0` builds the wiki without the page menu (copy, view as Markdown, assistant links, print), should it misbehave in production.
DOCS_PDF: `1` also builds a PDF of every page; CI sets it for every build it tests or deploys, a local build is quicker without.
GH_TOKEN: A GitHub token for reading the private sibling repositories and their releases: the dataset download, the pinned sibling docs, the repository-map check, the release-complete check and the sibling pin lag on the docs-health page. Preferred over `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
GITHUB_TOKEN: The fallback GitHub token when `GH_TOKEN` is not set (the token GitHub Actions provides); read by the same scripts.
HUKAMNAMA_API: The origin of the public Hukamnama API (`https://api.gurbanisoul.com`) the web server reads each day's record from to fill the Hukamnama pages. Unset (the default), or without a page shell for the language, the pages are not served. Must be `https://…` (or a local `http://127.0.0.1:` / `http://localhost:` address).
HUKAMNAMA_APNS_KEY_FILE: Path to the APNs Auth Key (`.p8`, PEM) the Hukamnama service signs its provider token with, as a Render secret file (`/etc/secrets/…`); needed only when `HUKAMNAMA_SEND=on`. The key itself never goes in an environment variable or the repository.
HUKAMNAMA_APNS_KEY_ID: The 10-character Key ID of that APNs Auth Key (Apple Developer → Keys); the `kid` of the provider token.
HUKAMNAMA_APNS_TEAM_ID: The Apple Developer Team ID that owns the APNs key; the `iss` of the provider token.
HUKAMNAMA_APNS_TOPIC: The APNs topic (the app's bundle id); default `org.sggs.app`.
HUKAMNAMA_ARCHIVE: Where the Hukamnama service keeps every distinct page it fetched from SGPC, gzip under each Amritsar date with an index of every fetch, kept 60 days (unset: no archive); the same as `serve --archive`. The image sets `/var/data/archive`.
HUKAMNAMA_COMMIT: The source commit the Hukamnama service reports on `/health` so a deploy is verified by identity; the image bakes it from Render's `RENDER_GIT_COMMIT` (falls back to that, then `unknown`).
HUKAMNAMA_DB: The scripture database the Hukamnama service reads (default `db/sggs.sqlite`); the same as its `--db` option.
HUKAMNAMA_MEANING: `on` adds the English translation (Dr. Sant Singh Khalsa) to the Hukamnama service's public snapshot as a separate, labelled layer (`lines[].en` and `translation`); anything else (the default) leaves it out, and switching it off removes it from the files on the next sync. The Gurmukhi is identical either way.
HUKAMNAMA_PUBLIC_ACCESS_KEY_ID: The access key id of an R2 API token scoped to the public snapshot bucket only (Object Read & Write). Not the backup's token.
HUKAMNAMA_PUBLIC_BUCKET: The R2 bucket the Hukamnama service writes its public snapshot to, for the edge Worker to serve (unset: no bucket). Needs `HUKAMNAMA_R2_ENDPOINT` and the two `HUKAMNAMA_PUBLIC_…` keys; with any of them missing the service refuses to start.
HUKAMNAMA_PUBLIC_DIR: Where the Hukamnama service writes its public snapshot: one file per published day plus an index, rewritten when a day is published, corrected or held (unset: no snapshot); the same as `serve --public-dir`.
HUKAMNAMA_PUBLIC_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: The secret of that R2 API token. Set only in the host's environment (Render); never in the repository or a log.
HUKAMNAMA_SEND: `on` makes the Hukamnama service push each published Hukamnama to registered devices through APNs; anything else (the default) keeps sending off. With `on` and no usable APNs key the service refuses to start.
HUKAMNAMA_STATE: The Hukamnama service's own state database: each day's fetched Hukamnama, the gate's decision and the audit trail (default `hukamnama-state.sqlite`); the same as its `--state` option.
LITESTREAM_SHA256: Build-time only, from the Hukamnama Dockerfile's build arg: the sha256 of that Litestream release archive, copied from the release's `checksums.txt`; the image build fails on a mismatch.
LITESTREAM_VERSION: Build-time only, from the Hukamnama Dockerfile's build arg: the Litestream release the image installs for the state backup to R2. Bumped together with `LITESTREAM_SHA256`.
PORT: The port to listen on, set by the host (Render, a container platform). The API prefers it to `SGGS_PORT`; the Hukamnama service defaults to 8080 without it.
PUBLIC_APP_STORE_LIVE: `1` once the app is live on the App Store: the pages show the store link, the Smart App Banner and the install URL; otherwise "Coming soon". Set in the production project on launch day.
PUBLIC_CONTRIBUTE_MODE: Which payment links the Contribute page carries: `live`, `test` (Stripe test mode, for staging) or `off` (the default, no links). A link that does not fit the mode fails the build.
PUBLIC_DOCS_COMMIT: The commit the wiki documents: it pins code excerpts and repository links, and is shown in the footer and in the `sggs-docs-commit` meta tag the deploy smoke test checks. CI passes it; locally it is read from git.
PUBLIC_I18N_PREVIEW: `all` also builds every drafted language that has a catalog, for a reviewer to read on real pages; never set for production.
PUBLIC_I18N_PSEUDO: `1` builds every catalog string as pseudo-text, so a string that bypasses the catalog, or a layout that cannot take a longer translation, stands out.
PUBLIC_NEWSLETTER_FORM_URL: The launch-notice sign-up form's address; without it the sign-up band is not built and the privacy page leaves out its section.
RENDER_GIT_COMMIT: Injected by Render: the commit being served, reported by `/api/health` → `commit` so a deploy is verified by identity.
SGGS_ACCESS_LOG: `0` turns off the one-line JSON access log written per request (default on); the generators that drive the API in-process set it.
SGGS_COMMIT: The source commit `/api/health` reports when the host does not inject `RENDER_GIT_COMMIT`; the generated API functions set it at deploy time.
SGGS_DB: The database file the API opens read-only; a per-context function points it at its own slice of the database. Default: `db/sggs.sqlite`.
SGGS_MAX_WORKERS: How many requests the threaded server handles at once before new ones queue (default 48).
SGGS_MODULES: Which bounded contexts this process serves: `all` (the default, the whole API) or a comma list such as `search` or `insights,knowledge`. An unknown name stops the server.
SGGS_OPEN_BROWSER: `1` opens the site in the desktop browser when the server starts; never set on a host.
SGGS_PORT: The API's local port when `PORT` is not set (default 7777), e.g. to run a second server beside another worktree's.
SGGS_READ_TOKEN: The third fallback for reading the pinned sibling docs, after `GH_TOKEN` and `GITHUB_TOKEN`; in CI it is the read-only token for the sibling repositories.
VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET: Vercel's protection-bypass secret, sent as `x-vercel-protection-bypass` so the contract replay and the function verification can reach a protected staging or preview deployment.
VERCEL_BYPASS: The protection-bypass secret the wiki's visual review script sends to reach a protected base URL such as the staging alias.
VERCEL_DOCS_BYPASS_SECRET: The wiki project's protection-bypass secret, sent by the post-deploy smoke test to reach a protected wiki deployment.
VERCEL_ORG_ID: The Vercel team the API calls of `scripts/ci/vercel_api.py` are made in; required with `VERCEL_TOKEN`.
VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: The Vercel project `scripts/ci/vercel_api.py has-production` asks about.
VERCEL_TOKEN: A Vercel API token for `scripts/ci/vercel_api.py` (which deployment serves a domain, a deployment's target, whether a project has a production deployment).
